title: `npm run health` runs the verifier in STATIC mode only, so the count ratchet is absent from the bar AGENTS.md names as THE bar (and from direct pushes
body:
Deferred from the 2026-08-28/29 audit fix pass. The finding was confirmed by an
adversarial verifier; it was not fixed in that pass for the reason below, which is
the fixing agent's own account after reading the code.

The remedy is in package.json:23/29 (add a drift invocation) or .github/workflows/ci.yml (drop the pull_request-only condition on the drift step) — both hard exclusions for me. Worth noting the slack it leaves is now materially smaller after the floor re-raise above.
